items.html: And you already know that the Yesod itself of Tevunah is above, between the tops of the upper articles of its NH, and slightly higher, and therefore it now enters after all of them. And behold, now he is nine years and one day old, for the one day corresponds to the corona of Tevunah, as mentioned. And behold, now he is complete in all the Mochin, in their true places — every aspect in the place befitting it, in the aforementioned manner — and his Daat is completed, in which are the five Hassadim, as is known.
